_readme: Release notes posted by the YEET Updates bot (see docs/changelog-bot.md). One object per entry: id (unique, sortable: YYYY-MM-DD-slug), text (English), tags (without the default #YeetUpdate). text + tags must fit in 420 characters — `cargo test changelog` checks it. Entries are posted oldest-first, at most CHANGELOG_BOT_MAX_PER_RUN per run, and never twice.

entries.text: Hi, I'm the YEET Updates bot. From now on every fix and new feature that ships to justyeet.it gets posted here as a permanent post, so you always know what changed. Follow me to stay in the loop.

New: Moods! Pick a color theme in Settings (Midnight, Sunset, Forest, Ocean, Violet, Mono, Arctic light). Also new: build your own Webboards from any RSS feed, and you can finally delete your own posts from the ⋯ menu.

The profile widget now shows your real name and points instead of a wallet address. And the NOTE → YEET swap page is live at justyeet.it/swap.html: 100 NOTE = 1 YEET, fixed rate. Swaps unlock once the YEET token contract is deployed – we will announce it here.

Fix: the German interface is now complete. Menu, search, tabs, login and registration, prompts, footer and post cards all follow the language you pick in Settings. Switching languages updates the page instantly, no reload needed.

YEET now speaks six languages: English, Deutsch, Italiano, Français, Español and Português. On your first visit we follow your browser language; you can change it any time under Settings → Language. Benvenuti, bienvenue, bienvenidos, bem-vindos!

Accessibility update: a screen reader mode (visible button labels, strong focus, keyboard shortcuts – press ? for help), high contrast and large text. Plus a built-in reader: have any post or the whole feed read aloud in the right language. Settings → Accessibility.

New: translate posts. Posts written in another language get a Translate button; one tap shows them in your language with the source noted. Turn on “Translate posts automatically” in Settings → Accessibility and foreign-language posts translate themselves as you scroll.

New: Audio Stories! Open the AUDIO tab, tap Record and talk – straight from your phone, up to 3 minutes. Add a short text about what it is, choose 24 hours or permanent, mark it 18+ if needed, publish. The reader plays stories for you, too.

Four more languages: Suomi, Svenska, Norsk and Íslenska. YEET now ships in ten languages – your browser language is picked automatically on first visit, or choose under Settings → Language. Tervetuloa, välkommen, velkommen, velkomin!

New: filter your feed by language and country. Settings → Feed filter lets you show only posts in your language (or a selection) and only from the countries you choose – change it any time. Set your own country there too so others can find your posts.

Čeština, Dansk, Nederlands and Polski have arrived – YEET now ships in fourteen languages. Your browser language is picked automatically on first visit, or choose under Settings → Language. Vítejte, velkommen, welkom, witajcie!

Hrvatski, Srpski, Türkçe and Latviešu are here – eighteen languages now. Your browser language is picked automatically on first visit, or choose under Settings → Language. Dobrodošli, dobrodošli, hoş geldiniz, laipni lūdzam!
Imprint, privacy policy, terms, cookie notice and disclaimer are now available in German as well. The legal pages follow your UI language and have a Deutsch / English switch at the top.
Translate and read-aloud now work everywhere: in the post detail view and on every comment (feed and detail). Tap the speaker to hear a comment, the globe to translate it into your language.

The NOTE → YEET swap page at justyeet.it/swap.html now speaks all eighteen YEET languages and follows the language you chose in the app. Same fixed rate, same rules: 100 NOTE = 1 YEET, no Yeet fee, swaps stay locked until the contract is live.

Ελληνικά, Magyar, Română and Български join YEET – twenty-two languages now, including the swap page. Your browser language is picked automatically on first visit, or choose under Settings → Language. Καλώς ήρθατε, üdvözlünk, bine ați venit, добре дошли!

Slovenčina, Slovenščina, Lietuvių and Eesti are live – twenty-six languages now, and every EU official language except Irish and Maltese. Your browser language is picked on first visit, or switch under Settings → Language. Vitajte, dobrodošli, sveiki atvykę, tere tulemast!

Fix: release notes from this account no longer vanish from the global feed after 24 hours. Regular permanent posts keep their 24h feed window and then live on the author's profile; official update posts stay in the feed for good and are never hidden by a language or country filter.

Gaeilge, Malti, Українська and Русский are live – thirty languages, and with Irish and Maltese every EU official language is now on board. Your browser language is picked on first visit, or switch under Settings → Language. Fáilte, merħba, ласкаво просимо, добро пожаловать!

The feed now scrolls on forever: For You, Following, Audio, NFT and profile timelines load the next posts automatically as you reach the end – no more 20-post cutoff. The NFT tab also shows every NFT post, not just the last 24 hours.

Català, Shqip, Bosanski and Македонски are live – thirty-four languages now, including the swap page. Your browser language is picked on first visit, or switch under Settings → Language. Benvinguts, mirësevini, dobrodošli, добредојдовте!

Euskara, Galego, Cymraeg and Lëtzebuergesch are live – thirty-eight languages now, including the swap page. Your browser language is picked on first visit, or switch under Settings → Language. Ongi etorri, benvidos, croeso, wëllkomm!

Permanent Posts is now the platform's archive: 'All' shows every public permanent post – these release notes included – with infinite scroll, 'Mine' shows your own. Also fixed: permanent posts from the early days that the expiry sweep had hidden are back, and the sweep never touches permanent posts again.

Fix: the Trending widget in the sidebar no longer gets stuck on 'Loading…'. It now fills in after you log in, waits for slow connections instead of giving up after three seconds, says so when nothing is trending yet, and its entries open the post. Trending looks at the newest 50 posts instead of 20.

Compliance: every YEET payout address is now screened against the OFAC sanctions list before anything moves on-chain – when you link a wallet, when you convert points and again in the payout batch. Clean addresses notice nothing; a listed address is refused with a clear message. The list refreshes daily.

Pay-per-View now asks for your express consent before a purchase: you confirm that the content is delivered immediately and that the 14-day right of withdrawal is waived, as EU consumer law requires for digital content. Price and the 90/10 creator/platform split are shown up front, you get a confirmation email, and every purchase is listed under Token Tips.

Fixes: your 18+ setting now stays on after logging in again (it was only restored on a full page reload); opening a post from the Trending widget no longer claims it doesn't exist when your session just needed a refresh; and the Pay-per-View unlock button works in the main feed, not only in the Trending view.

WalletConnect v2 is here: sign in with Trust Wallet, MetaMask Mobile, Rainbow and other mobile wallets – scan the QR code on desktop or tap through on your phone. The same wallet is then used for linking, encrypted messages and future on-chain actions. Nothing is loaded unless you pick it.

Terms of Service updated (section 6): points are platform points, not a crypto-asset, not purchasable, no cash value, not transferable. YEET only ever sits in your own wallet; we never hold it for you. Points-to-YEET conversion is one-way, min. 100 points, reviewed before release, with points returned if a request is refused.

Fixed: opening a post from the Trending widget (or any direct post link) failed with "Database error" when the author was the YEET Updates bot or an email-only account. The post detail now loads with the same data as a feed card, including media, tip total and pay-per-view state.
